mentions.name: Price & Volume
mentions.description: iOS app that displays stock price and volume side by side, color-coded with gradients so it is easy to see whether price and volume are following or breaking trends.
mentions.problem: It is often helpful to see whether volume supports price action.
mentions.audience: It is often helpful to see volume supports price action.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Price & Volume: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/stock-price-volume/id6760153550
It is often helpful to see volume supports price action. I have the price/volume change color-coded with gradients so it is easy to see if they are following or breaking trends
